dish: bún bò Huế thập cẩm (spicy lemongrass beef noodle soup)
address: 274/29 Võ Văn Tần, Ward 5, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Family-run bún bò Huế in a narrow District 3 alley; a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand for its rich lemongrass-and-beef-bone broth and generous mixed bowl.

dish: street snacks — bánh tráng trộn, ốc, snacks along a 1km night food street
address: Nguyễn Thượng Hiền (Điện Biên Phủ to Nguyễn Đình Chiểu), Bàn Cờ Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: District 3's official night food street (opened Dec 2022) on a stretch Time Out ranked among the world's coolest; ~90 stalls of bánh tráng trộn, snails and skewers, 7pm–11pm.

dish: Cambodian-Vietnamese street food — num banh chok, Khmer chè, grilled skewers
address: Hồ Thị Kỷ, Ward 1, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 300m alley market settled by Vietnamese-Cambodian refugees in the 1970s, now Saigon's densest Cambodian-Vietnamese food alley (100+ stalls); Khmer fish noodles, prahok and palm-sugar chè, from ~3pm.

dish: bún num bò chóc (Khmer turmeric-and-prahok snakehead fish noodle soup)
n: Bún Num Bò Chóc Tư Xê
address: 57/17 Hồ Thị Kỷ, Ward 1, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The name Saigon foodies invoke for num banh chok: a golden turmeric broth built on snakehead fish and Cambodian prahok, run by Tư Xê, who brought the recipe back from Cambodia in 1972.

dish: bánh đúc nóng (warm rice-flour pudding with minced pork and wood-ear)
address: 116/2/3 Phan Đăng Lưu, Ward 3, Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 40-year alley institution off Phan Đăng Lưu famous for warm bánh đúc ladled to order with pork, wood-ear mushroom and fried shallots; once notorious for its brusque service.
